core.title: Media details screen, resume playback and watchlist
covers: details screen with Play as default focus
core.guidance: Details: the primary action is Play (or Resume with the remaining time and a Start over alternative) and it takes default focus; metadata is a short scannable block (duration, year, rating, badges as text not colour), synopsis ≤3 lines with an expander, episodes as a rail or list with progress bars and the next unwatched episode preselected; secondary actions (watchlist, trailer, more like this) sit after Play in one row. Resume: a continue-watching row shows progress on each card, resumes at the saved position, and removes finished items; entering a title from the row returns focus to that card. Watchlist: one toggle with a clear on/off state and text label, works from cards and details, and is reflected immediately in the watchlist row. Everything is reachable with D-pad UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT and BACK returns to the row that launched the details.
core.use_when: Title/episode details, continue-watching rows, watchlist actions in a streaming or catch-up app.
core.avoid_when: Live-only channels without on-demand content (use the guide and player rules).

implementation.compose-tv: focusRequester on the Play button in the details Column; LazyRow with focusRestorer for episodes; remember the launching card key to restore focus on BACK.

core.title: Focus is the action (TV)
core.guidance: No 'button-like' cards with an inner button; the whole card is focusable and selectable. Detail screen: ≤4 actions in one row, first focus on Play/Resume, LEFT/RIGHT between them, DOWN to rails. Long press or a Menu key can open secondary actions. Never require diagonal or multi-key gestures.
core.use_when: TV browse/detail screens: the focused card is the call to action, SELECT opens, and detail screens expose a small row of focusable buttons (Play, Resume, Add to list) with a deterministic first focus.

core.title: Horizontal rails (rows of content)
core.guidance: Each rail has a visible title, focused item scrolls to a fixed pivot (about 20–30% from the left) rather than centring, rails remember their last focused index when returning, row heights are consistent within a rail, and off-screen items are partially visible to signal continuation. Lazy-load rails and images; never render every rail on first paint. Keep the safe margin (~5% / 48 dp horizontal, 27 dp vertical at 960×540 dp).
core.use_when: TV browsing of categorised content: vertical axis moves between categories, horizontal axis moves within a category. The default TV home structure.
core.avoid_when: Fewer than ~8 items total (use a grid or list), or content that must be compared side by side.

implementation.compose-tv: LazyColumn of LazyRow (Compose Foundation ≥1.7 has focus-aware scrolling); wrap each row in focusRestorer(); set LocalBringIntoViewSpec for the pivot; TvLazyRow is deprecated.

core.title: Mini player / picture-in-picture state
core.guidance: The mini player is a single focusable/tappable region anchored to a corner (TV: bottom-right inside the safe margin, never over the focused rail; mobile: bottom above the tab bar; web: bottom-right) with the title (one line, truncated with a full title on focus), live/progress indicator and exactly two actions (expand, close); on TV, SELECT expands to the full player and BACK from the full player returns to the mini state with focus restored to the element that was focused before; playback state (playing/paused/buffering/error) is shown with an icon plus text, and the audio keeps playing while the UI is navigated; the region is excluded from the rail's D-pad focus loop except through an explicit UP/RIGHT move; never autoplay audio from a mini player on page load on web.
core.use_when: Playback continues while the user browses (home rails, EPG, queue) on TV, or while navigating a mobile/web app.
core.avoid_when: Content that must not play in the background (paid live events with strict windows) or when the platform provides system PiP that the app should adopt instead.

implementation.compose-tv: Box aligned BottomEnd with padding 48.dp; focusProperties { up/left = FocusRequester.Default }; BackHandler ordering: full player → mini → home.
implementation.compose: Use PictureInPicture params when the app is backgrounded; in-app mini via a Scaffold bottom slot above the NavigationBar.

core.selected_for: required coverage: loading, empty and error states, TV safe margins

core.title: TV rail (horizontal row of cards)
covers: media card with one focus target and one status overlay
core.guidance: Rail title (≥24 sp) left-aligned in the safe area, cards of one aspect ratio, focused card scrolls to a fixed pivot (~10–30% from left) with LEFT at index 0 going to navigation, focus memory per rail, lazy loading of items and images, 'see all' as the last card if the rail is capped, no wrap-around, consistent card counts per width (Android: ~4 landscape / ~6 portrait at 960 dp).
core.use_when: Categorised browsing on TV home, section, and search screens.
core.avoid_when: Fewer than ~4 items (use a grid row), comparison tasks.

implementation.compose-tv: LazyRow inside LazyColumn with focusRestorer() and LocalBringIntoViewSpec for pivot; item keys stable; contentPadding = safe margins.

guardrails.title: TV: 10-foot typography
guardrails.guidance: Body ≥24 sp (Android) / ≥29 pt (tvOS) at 1080p design scale, captions ≥20 sp, titles 32–48, display 57–72; sans with large x-height and open counters; short strings (titles ≤2 lines, synopsis ≤3 lines with expansion); avoid thin weights (<400) and light text on busy imagery; line height ≥1.3.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never scale a desktop type ramp up by a factor; rebuild the scale for distance and for reduced text volume.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: accessibility, 10-foot typography, readable at distance

guardrails.title: Focus visible and not obscured
guardrails.guidance: Focus indicator ≥2 px with ≥3:1 contrast against adjacent colours and against the unfocused state; sticky UI gets scroll-padding so a focused control scrolls into clear view. On TV the indicator must be obvious at 3 m (scale + border/glow).
guardrails.use_when: Every focusable element in every theme; sticky headers, footers, toasts, and cookie banners must never cover the focused element.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never remove focus styles; use :focus-visible to hide them for mouse clicks only.

guardrails.title: TV: vertical = sections, horizontal = items
guardrails.guidance: Every focusable element must be reachable with straight UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT presses; no diagonal reasoning, no hidden hops. Search and settings live at a predictable edge. Grids: LEFT at the first column may enter side navigation, RIGHT at the last column stays. Forms: one field per row, DOWN advances.
guardrails.use_when: Any TV layout: rails, grids, menus, settings, forms.
guardrails.avoid_when: Avoid nested horizontal groups inside horizontal groups; avoid controls placed where no straight DPAD path reaches them.
